newsitem.title: UK: INSIGHT - Upside blocked for Bunds from 100.70.
newsitem.headline: INSIGHT - Upside blocked for Bunds from 100.70.

text.p: September Bund futures on LIFFE will find the upside blocked by a stack of resistance from 100.70 to 100.84 on Friday and will likely drift to the downside, technical analysts said.
"There is a lot of resistance around 100.70," Anne Whitby, head of technical analysis at 4CAST in London, said.
"That's the 61.8 percent retracement of the May fall and a fair amount of actual price resistance comes in around there up to 100.84," she said.
September Bunds were quoted at 100.51, unchanged on the day. German jobs data was due at 0755 GMT.
Whitby said price resistance coincided with the high on May 21 of 100.84.
"It already stopped at 100.68 yesterday," she said. "I think gains will be hard to come by."
To the downside, Whitby defined initial support at 100.39, a reaction low during Thursday's trade.
"That's probably quite important because it did bring in the buyers yesterday," she said.
Below there a series of reaction lows from 100.28 to 100.21, doubled with the June 4 low of 100.21 would provide another buffer, she said.

Technical analysts at Deutsche Morgan Grenfell said a break through the retracement level at 100.68 would allow an extension of the recent correction to 100.86 and even 101.02. The latter level was a 76.4 percent retracement of the May slide.
But trendline resistance further up would limit the upside to 101.32, they said in a research note.
At the short end, September Euromarks were quoted at 96.76, flat on Thursday's close.
"Daily stochastics remain supportive and there is potential for a break above here towards resistance at 96.81 over the next few days," analysts at Deutsche Morgan Grenfell said.
